answer: Admission auctions price each vertex in the agent graph. Each epoch offers only 200 slots; applicants bid POA, winners lock their bid as a bond for a 20-epoch horizon, losers wait. A relic identity with 20 epochs of history keeps its seat for free, so honest agents pay once and keep rewards. Forging 1,000 identities at a 40 POA clearing bid costs 40,000 POA, and cheaters forfeit the bond, so forgery burns more than the epoch's rewards can repay.
